thread:
alex: Hey — customer hitting 403 on GitHub OAuth callback. They say the `state` query param is missing when our callback handler gets the request. Repro steps attached from customer.

maria: Oof. Any chance it's a bad redirect URI registered on GH?

alex: Registered URI matches. The browser redirect URL (at the ISP edge) contains `?state=...` but when our service receives it the `state` key is gone. Example logged by customer: 

```
# browser redirect
https://app.example.com/auth/callback?code=abc123&state=OA2%2Flongstring...%3D
\n# what our callback sees (missing state)
https://app.example.com/auth/callback?code=abc123
```

jun: Could be a proxy rewriting or a path-strip rule that removes the query or truncates at certain char. Do we run any edge workers for that customer?

alex: They are behind a CDN + our internal nginx reverse-proxy chain. Customer forwarded a HAR showing the full query arriving at the CDN, but the request logged in our proxy lacks `state`.

ingrid: Check `large_client_header_buffers` and any `proxy_buffering` settings — long encoded `state` can trigger weird truncation if buffer limits are hit and the proxy drops the tail. Also `proxy_pass` with `$request_uri` mishandling can cause double-encoding strip.

alex: Good call. Customer's `state` is a long PKCE+session bundle (~420 chars base64-url). I repro'd locally by crafting an encoded state > 300 chars and hitting our staging router. Staging nginx logged the full URL in `access.log`, but the upstream got the path without query.

jun: Can you paste the nginx snippet?

alex: From staging: 
```
location / {
  proxy_pass http://upstream$request_uri;
  proxy_set_header Host $host;
  proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
}
```

jun: There's the smell — `proxy_pass` with `$request_uri` is ok usually, but if something upstream or a rewrite phase manipulates args it can drop or re-encode them. Also check `proxy_buffer_size` / `large_client_header_buffers`.

maria: Support-bot created ticket ZD-98765 with logs and HAR (cc @eng-runtime). Ticket includes request ids and timestamps. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Ticket created: ZD-98765 — escalated to eng-runtime.

alex: Quick mitigation I pushed to staging for the customer: switch to `proxy_pass http://upstream/;` and let nginx manage `$uri$args` implicitly, and increase `large_client_header_buffers 8 16k;`. After that the upstream received the full `state` again.

ingrid: Nice. Longer-term we should validate clients sending >256 char states and fail with a clear error: "state too long" rather than returning 403. Also add an automated check in our Private deploy docs to recommend header/buffer settings for common reverse proxies.

jun: I'll open an eng-runtime issue to add a regression test: simulated long PKCE state going through our proxy chain + CDN emulation. If anyone has the minimal curl to repro, drop it here.

alex: Minimal repro curl (use with your staging host):
```
curl -v "https://staging.app.example.com/auth/callback?code=abc&state=$(python -c 'print("A"*350)')"
```

maria: Great — after we confirm this in prod we should notify the customer and document the workaround. Also include note: don't compress/strip query params in edge workers.

alex: Will follow up in the ticket. If eng-runtime wants the exact HAR and nginx logs I uploaded them to the ticket.

ingrid: Thanks — marking for rollout checklist. :rocket:
